instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an outdoor paved path. On the left, the dark-haired woman in a black long-sleeved top and pants (R1) walks forward, stepping with her left foot and looking down. Her left hand rests on the shoulder of the white-haired woman in a black short-sleeved dress (R2) on the right, who also steps forward with her left foot while looking down. They walk side-by-side in natural daylight.
elements: R1 rests her left hand on R2's shoulder while they walk
R2 is the person whose shoulder is being touched by R1
R1 and R2 walk side-by-side with R1 maintaining shoulder contact
both R1 and R2 step forward while looking down
the interaction takes place on an outdoor paved path

questions.q: Is R1 resting her left hand on R2's shoulder, rather than R2 resting her hand on R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1 is the active shoulder-contact person

questions.element: R2 is the receiver of R1's shoulder contact

questions.element: R1 maintains shoulder contact as they walk together

questions.q: Does R2 walk forward beside R1 as the person whose shoulder is being touched by R1?
